lower_constructions.N1_semantics: TIER PROTOTYPE, a NON-oracle runtime-legal query: the normalized mean of the vectored content facets of the KB units in the trajectory's own tier. The sample id alone determines the tier, so no gold is used. It carries the correct tier prior and ZERO information about the individual utterance, which is exactly what makes it a floor rather than a bound

oracle_bound.twin_stratification_note: POST-REGISTRATION AND LABELLED AS SUCH. O3's self-exclusion withholds the query facet itself, but the first run showed that several gold tools carry EXACT DUPLICATE utterances, so a withheld facet can still be matched at cosine 1.0 by its own twin -- identity leak by duplication rather than by self-match. The O3_TWIN_* fields re-read the SAME O3 loop with the 0.99 threshold applied to every query's best OTHER gold-bearing cosine. The threshold was chosen after the numbers were seen; the stratification can only make the headline weaker or equal, and it never replaces the pre-registered O3 count

utterance_leak_check.semantics: eval_UNITS_present_in_the_kb must be 0 -- that is the BLOCK decontamination `propose_partition` enforces fail-closed. A TEXT match is a WEAKER and separate condition: two different query_idx blocks may carry the same invocation string, in which case that evaluation utterance's embedding IS on disk under another facet id. Only a text match on a DISPATCHED trajectory would touch this row's oracle framing, so that count is reported separately
